note: One job per unresolved crosswalk subject. The count is derived from the generated crosswalk on every run and is never hardcoded. Two are official-retrieval obligations blocked on primary authority this repository does not hold; one is a compiled-runtime gap whose authority is already committed.

jobs.subject: compiled_pathway:PA:path-k-human-trafficking-vacatur-expungement
jobs.authorityScope: Within 18 Pa.C.S. ch. 30. The operative vacatur/expungement provision itself — a definitions or penalties section of ch. 30 does not close this.
jobs.issuingBody: Pennsylvania General Assembly, via the Legislative Reference Bureau
jobs.requiredOfficialText: Verbatim statutory text of the human-trafficking victim vacatur/expungement remedy: who may petition, for which offences, on what showing, and what relief the court orders. Any official petition form referenced by the section.
officialSources: https://www.legis.state.pa.us — Pa. Consolidated Statutes, Title 18, ch. 30
jobs.repositoryDestination: private/Nationwide Record Clearing/Pennsylvania/statutes/18-pacs-3019.(txt|pdf) with the citation recorded in src/lib/rcap/state-packs/pennsylvania/
jobs.sourceReceipt: docs/record-clearing/source-receipts/PA-18-pacs-3019.md — retrieval URL, retrieval date, issuing body, and the SHA-256 of the committed file
jobs.owner: external-retrieval lane (outbound access or law-library access required)
jobs.stopCondition: The committed text states the vacatur/expungement remedy operatively, OR the retrieved chapter is shown to contain no such remedy. A proven absence closes this as a crosswalk terminal classification just as well as a proven text.
jobs.milestone1Item2Effect: Closes one of the two remaining pathway blockers, and closes the PA surplus — Pennsylvania is the only jurisdiction of seven whose compiled surplus is not fully explained, and this pathway is the reason.
jobs.researchExhaustion: Repository-only research is already recorded as exhausted for this subject. Do not re-run it; every coding terminal in this sprint is egress-blocked to legislative hosts.
jobs.missingEvidence: Official primary authority named in docs/record-clearing/retrieval-packets/compiled_pathway_PA_path-k-human-trafficking-vacatur-expungement.md; not committed to this repository.
jobs.nextAction: Retrieve the official primary text per docs/record-clearing/retrieval-packets/compiled_pathway_PA_path-k-human-trafficking-vacatur-expungement.md, commit it, then re-run the canonical generator.

officialSources: https://www.scstatehouse.gov — S.C. Code of Laws, Title 16, ch. 3
